evidence.reason: After edit, subscriptionCharge no longer calls metering.initialize() and passes "benchmark" instead of "monthly" to metering.evaluate, changing the plan-dependent pricing path that tests exercise.
New function mutates shared history via history.splice and reads configuration.rate and chargeUnit, introducing shared-state and configuration dependencies not present before.
Test asserts evaluate(20, 0.1, "monthly") > 0 and subscriptionCharge(40) > 0; the plan change to "benchmark" and removal of initialize() may violate these expectations.

result.userExplanation: 这两处改动可能破坏订阅计费对 monthly 计划和 metering 初始化的依赖，建议先确认调用方与测试是否仍按原契约工作。
result.suggestedAction: 请 src/subscription.ts#subscriptionCharge 的作者恢复 metering.initialize() 调用并将 metering.evaluate 的 plan 参数改回 "monthly"，或同步更新 test/metering.test.mjs 与调用方以匹配新的 "benchmark" 行为。
